source_refs.note: 4. Elastic Collisions: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Collisions between gas molecules, and between molecules and walls of the container are perfectly elastic. This means that there is no net loss of kinetic energy during collisions. The total kinetic energy is conserved.
